params.blurb2: Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Leona's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

Allied {{tip|champions|champions'}} damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal {{as|{{pplevel|32 to 151}}|magic damage}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.notes:
* ''Sunlight's'' damage respects {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* {{ci|Zyra}} has a hidden passive that grants her 10% increased size for {{tt|33 seconds|Estimated}} after having ''Sunlight'' applied to her.

blurb.plain: Innate: Leona abilities briefly mark enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal magic damage.

description.plain: Innate: Leona's abilities mark enemies hit for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Allied champions' damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal 32 – 151 (based on level) bonus magic damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Leona}} illuminates her shield, causing her next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun}} the target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' illuminates her shield, empowering her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} the target for 1 second.
params.description2: ''Shield of Daybreak {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Leona's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
** {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not interact with ''Shield of Daybreak's'' bonus damage.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Shield of Daybreak's'' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}}, {{tip|block|blocking}}.
** ''Shield of Daybreak's'' attack can {{tip|blind|miss}}, nullifying its effects entirely.
* ''Shield of Daybreak's'' attack does not put '''Leona's''' basic attack on cooldown.
** This effectively performs a second {{tip|basic attack reset|attack reset}}.
** This is unlike nearly every other empowered attack spell (including those which, similar to ''Shield of Daybreak'', formerly used a more unconventional spell-cast as an attack rather than an attack override).
** '''Leona''' will wait out ''Shield of Daybreak's'' wind-down before automatically attacking, anyway. The player must issue the next attack themselves to gain the full benefit of the second reset.
** ''Shield of Daybreak'' shares this feature with {{cai|Thundering Smash|Volibear}} and {{cai|Emberstrike|Shyvana}}.
* The empowered attack can trigger against {{tip|turrets}} exclusively.

blurb.plain: Active: Leona illuminates her shield, causing her next basic attack within a few seconds to deal bonus magic damage and briefly stun the target.

description.plain: Active: Leona illuminates her shield, empowering her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, deal bonus magic damage and stun the target for 1 second.

description2.plain: Shield of Daybreak resets Leona's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Leona}} raises her ''guard'' for a short time, gaining flat damage reduction, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
params.blurb2: Her shield detonates afterward, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, '''Leona's''' ''guard'' is extended for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' raises her ''guard'' for 3 seconds, gaining flat {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage reduction of up to 50% of the damage instance and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
params.description2: Her shield detonates after the duration, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, '''Leona's''' ''guard'' is extended for an additional 3 seconds.
params.notes:
* Neither the cast nor detonation of ''Eclipse'' interrupts any of '''Leona's''' previous orders or ongoing attack windups.
* The resistance scaling will factor from all other sources, excluding ''Eclipse's'' flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage but ''Eclipse's'' extended duration will not be prevented.

blurb.plain: Active: Leona raises her guard for a short time, gaining flat damage reduction, bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

blurb2.plain: Her shield detonates afterward, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, Leona's guard is extended for a short time.

description.plain: Active: Leona raises her guard for 3 seconds, gaining flat pre-mitigation damage reduction of up to 50% of the damage instance and bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

description2.plain: Her shield detonates after the duration, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits an enemy, Leona's guard is extended for an additional 3 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Leona}} projects her sword in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: If she hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, she will {{tip|dash}} to the last one struck and briefly {{tip|root}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' projects her sword in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: After reaching its maximum range, if the sword hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} during its flight, '''Leona''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to 225 units beyond the location of the last champion struck and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description3: '''''Leona''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Zenith Blade is in flight. She can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
params.notes:
* '''Leona''' will fail to {{tip|dash}} to and {{tip|root}} the last champion struck if they are not within 3000 units of her by the time the sword missile fizzles from reaching maximum range.
* '''Leona''' will '''not''' track the target if they change locations during her dash.
** She will only dash to their current location at the time the sword fizzled.
* The {{tip|root}} application on the last champion struck is applied at an inconsistent timing.{{bug|2}}
* '''Leona''' will be ordered to basic attack the target she dashed to, after her dash completes.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage, and prevent '''Leona''' from dashing as the last champion struck by her sword.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

blurb.plain: Active: Leona projects her sword in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: If she hits at least one enemy champion, she will dash to the last one struck and briefly root them.

description.plain: Active: Leona projects her sword in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

description2.plain: After reaching its maximum range, if the sword hit an enemy champion during its flight, Leona dashes to 225 units beyond the location of the last champion struck and roots them for 0.5 seconds.

description3.plain: Leona is unable to move or attack while Zenith Blade is in flight. She can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Leona}} calls down a solar flare that strikes upon the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: Enemies hit are briefly {{tip|slow|slowed}}, or {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration if they are hit by the epicenter.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Leona''' calls down a solar flare that strikes upon the target location after {{fd|0.625}} seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before impact and for another 3 seconds afterwards. Enemies hit are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 80% for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, and are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration if they are struck by the epicenter.
params.notes:
* ''Solar Flare's'' visual effects are only visible to enemies if they have {{tip|sight}} of the area it was cast upon.
* The cast indicator shows 300 radius for the [[area of effect]] and 120 radius for the epicenter, however the actual hitbox radii are larger than those values.
* The revealed radius is not obstructed by [[terrain]] or {{tip|brush}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Leona calls down a solar flare that strikes upon the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: Enemies hit are briefly slowed, or stunned for the same duration if they are hit by the epicenter.

description.plain: Active: Leona calls down a solar flare that strikes upon the target location after 0.625 seconds, granting sight of the area before impact and for another 3 seconds afterwards. Enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed by 80% for 1.75 seconds, and are also stunned for the same duration if they are struck by the epicenter.
